youtube_title: John Dillinger's escape from Crown Point's 'escape-proof' jail, and the voices visitors hear
body: In 1934, Crown Point's Lake County Jail was supposed to be escape-proof. On March 3, John Dillinger pulled a gun on his guards. Legend says he'd carved it from wood and blackened it with shoe polish, though some say it was real. He locked more than a dozen guards and inmates in the cells, took the sheriff's own car and fled into Illinois, and taking a stolen car across a state line brought federal agents into the hunt. 🔦 Today you can tour the old jail in season, and visitors say they hear voices in the cells and footsteps in the walkways.
